answer_1.quote: ...tasks like data-to-text generation, where the information conveyed by the output is intended to be entirely controlled by the information contained in the input...
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual descriptions produced by the five NLG systems for each set of input RDF triples.

answer_2.quote: ...We meta-evaluate 29 evaluation methods in terms of their ability to predict human semantic consistency ratings; the methods fall into five method types: embeddings-based, overlap-based, edit-distance, learned regressors, and LLM judges.

answer_3.quote: ...We extend our tests to LLM-as-judge methods, prompting three pre-trained models (Command-r-plus, Llama3-70B, Mistral-7B) to rate semantic consistency on a 1-3 scale...
methods: prompted LLMs to rate semantic consistency on a 1-3 scale

answer_4.quote: ...Each text was rated by three annotators on a 3-point scale for semantic adequacy ('Does the text correctly represent the input triples?'), and we use the mean score.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked: 'Does the text correctly represent the input triples?' and rated on a 3-point semantic adequacy scale.
